residue.current: the open made DEMOS/WAVE DANCER current — removed, then the stored collection as found
residue.undoRing: cleared to one row, the state as found (1 row, cursor 0 before) — a project open clears it and its rows cannot be written back
residue.unsavedGuard: dirty as found (force=1) — re-armed against a key the state as found does not match (the notebook text + U+2063 for the one markClean, then the text as found): the baseline the page had cannot be read back from outside, so the mark stays dirty until a SAVE, an open or NEW

gas128.skipped: not in the axial gas — entering the box rewrites the register and the undo ring, so it is not done for you; open OPERATOR → BOX with the AXIAL basis and run the report again to measure it

restored.cardRoad: setCardStyle (this browser had already chosen a card)
restored.traces: a play advances the SHADOW trail, the dynamics history and particles; none is project state
